verdicts.evidence: The environment test selects whether binaryTargets is populated from PRISMA_CLI_BINARY_TARGETS, and that value is passed to the engine download call (s1, f1:47). This is an environment gate modifying the requested binary artifacts, rather than merely their storage location or launch method.

The conditional assigns comma-separated environment values to binaryTargets when the variable is truthy, otherwise leaving it undefined (s2). Passing binaryTargets to the engine download call makes this a gate modifying the requested binary artifacts (f1:47, f1:52).
